themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously, collaborate, and execute workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content detailing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code, often integrating into IDEs.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Broad coverage of AI tools and platforms used to enhance or automate various aspects of research processes.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications specifically within the UI/UX design process, including tools for prototyping and generation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation and use of AI-generated personas, voices, or media that mimic human characteristics.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content about AI tools and techniques that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in testing and evaluating the usability and functionality of digital products and services.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Covers AI applications in qualitative research methods, such as analyzing interviews and open-ended feedback.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussions on how AI affects job markets, skills, and the future of work.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles investigating the behavior, impact, and risks of AI chatbots, particularly in user interactions.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
